passed.label: PRICE-SCALE-MAGNITUDE-FOOTGUN
passed.ledgerMatch: none (NEW contract — no prior fingerprint for NFTStakerPriceScaled.sol)
passed.rationale: Survives sanitization. The KI list blesses 'floor rounding conservative-for-protocol' (CLAUDE.md spec item 3 / Critical Invariants) and 'zero-APY collapse' (totalStaked==0 || targetAPY==0 || price==0 => R=0) as INTENDED behaviors, but neither covers an operator supplying a wrong-magnitude immutable priceScale at deploy time. That mis-sizing (too-high => collapsed runway / premature depletion; too-low => re-introduces floor-to-zero; plus the dispatcher-repoint corollary that the immutable pins a single price-token-decimal regime) is a distinct, non-obvious deploy-time hazard not anticipated by any documented intended behavior. A competent non-malicious owner would be surprised that an unchecked immutable silently mis-sizes the emission runway => Law-3 footgun, in scope. Solvency is structurally insensitive and the owner self-corrects via setTargetAPY, so it is correctly capped at Low (NOT H/M). Note: the absurd-value leg reverts as obvious misconfig (the dropped PS-004 'immutable-deploy-misconfig'), which is correctly Law-3-suppressed in dedup; the surviving canonical finding is the NON-obvious silent-mis-sizing magnitude footgun, which is NOT obvious-misconfig and stays in scope (Law 1: do not over-suppress).

perInstance.matchedTo: Mitigated by OZ nonReentrant (CLAUDE.md spec item: ReentrancyGuard via OpenZeppelin); in-system callee; byte-identical to the already-audited NFTStaker.sol baseline (the corresponding NFTStaker reentrancy hits were already triaged and not reported above Low). Tool-noise, low-confidence, not a new finding. Suppress.

Deliberate — only the price field of the configs() tuple feeds the priceScale multiply; ignoring the rest of the tuple is intentional and matches the audited NFTStaker baseline pattern (spec item 3 latestPrice = price/r). Tool-noise. Suppress.

Deliberate and byte-identical to the audited NFTStaker baseline — per-second emissions and windowEnd comparisons are inherently timestamp-based by design (CLAUDE.md spec items 2/4: masterchef per-second emissions, windowEnd = now + V/R). Block-timestamp manipulation is not a viable vector on this accrual math. Suppress.

removals.rationale: All four instances are confidence:low static-analyzer hits that are byte-identical to, or deliberate copies of, behavior in the already-audited NFTStaker.sol baseline, and each maps to a documented intended behavior or the Law-3 owner-trust known-invalid. None is a new finding. Law-1 check satisfied: none was suppressed merely to tidy — each has a concrete KI/baseline/deliberate-design match.

A literal hash compare would mark this 'new'. It is NOT new: it is byte-identical inherited code from an already-triaged WONT-FIX Medium. Sanitizer overrides the literal-hash 'new' classification with a semantic known-wont-fix suppression so the closed baseline entry is not re-opened.
removals.regressionNote: NOT a regression. M-02 is status=wont-fix (acknowledged), NOT fixed — there is no 'fixed' entry to reappear. This is a faithful-inherited copy of an open-but-accepted issue, not the reappearance of a remediated bug. emergencyWithdraw forfeits pending + skips _syncBudget/_updatePool BY DESIGN per CLAUDE.md spec item 1, so the inherited behavior is also story-faithful.
removals.rationale: Suppress / carry as context only; do not re-report and do not create a new ledger entry that would shadow the accepted NFTStaker M-02. CLAUDE.md emergencyWithdraw spec (forfeits reward, skips _syncBudget/_updatePool, callable while paused) is the documented intended escape-hatch behavior the over-emission is a known accepted side effect of.

informationalContext.label: FLOOR-BEFORE-AMPLIFY-PRECISION-NEGLIGIBLE
informationalContext.rationale: Floor-before-scale division precision in the priceScale arithmetic path is provably bounded (<1/latestPrice_unscaled ~2.5 ppb) and conservative-for-protocol (rounds against the user, never toward over-mint) — directly consistent with CLAUDE.md 'Math.mulDiv floor rounding (conservative for a reward contract)'. Recorded as a refuted/non-issue so it is not re-surfaced next run. Not suppressed-as-invalid; logged as a proven non-defect.
